title: OutputEvent
description: One raw output event from a lane capture — either an evdev record (JSM lane, evdev_capture.py --jsonl) or an XI2 record (Steam lane, xi2_capture.py capture --jsonl). The union of both capture schemas; 'plane' identifies which.

t.description: Wall-clock epoch seconds at capture time

plane.description: Observation plane: evdev = JSM lane (/dev/input/event*); xi2 = Steam lane (XI2/Xwayland seat)

flag.description: Device-class flag from xi2_capture.py (xi2 plane only, e.g. 'Xwayland-seat(XTEST/libei/phys)')

type.description: evdev event type string (evdev plane only: KEY, REL, ABS, SYN)

event.description: XI2 event type string (xi2 plane only: KeyPress, KeyRelease, RawKeyPress, …)

code.description: Event code: KEY_SPACE, BTN_LEFT, REL_X (evdev); keysym name F9 or 'kc<n>' (xi2)

value.description: Event value: 1=down, 0=up for KEY/BTN (evdev); axis value for REL/ABS; null for xi2 key events
